title: Al-Fajr 89:25-30 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-Baqarah 285 to 286; madd laazim and 'aarid
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 33 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Fajr 89:25-30 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 33. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ (٢٥) وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ (٢٦) يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ (٢٧)
ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ (٢٨) فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى (٢٩) وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى (٣٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
[To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Madd silah kubra: small waw before a hamza
Idgham with ghunnah: tanween into م

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Fajr 89:25-30 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 89:25-30 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 89:25-30 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite the whole of Al-Fajr 19 to 30 to a partner.
Why does «رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ» have ghunnah but «أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا» does not?
questions.a: Idgham into م has ghunnah; idgham into ل has none.

questions.q: Where is the soul at peace told to enter (89:30)?
questions.a: A) Allah's Paradise. 89:30: 'And enter My Paradise.'

questions.q: Al-Fajr 89:28: «ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: What do you think it means for a soul to be 'at peace' (al-mutma'innah)?
questions.a: Calm and content with Allah, trusting Him; Allah calls that soul to return to Him pleased (89:27 to 28).
